# Zuzana Irsova

Zuzana Irsova is Professor of Economics at Charles University in Prague, Distinguished Senior Lecturer at Anglo-American University and a Research Affiliate at METRICS, Stanford. She specializes in labor economics, international economics and meta-research. Her work brings together estimates from many studies to examine publication bias and the reliability of empirical evidence. Born in Roznava, Slovakia, she lives in Litomysl, Bohemia.

Name variants: Zuzana Iršová, Zuzana Iršová Havránková, Zuzana Havránková.

## Key facts

- Zuzana Irsova is Professor of Economics at Charles University, Prague, since 2025. [Source](https://ies.fsv.cuni.cz/en/contacts/institute-members/73504033) [Source](https://www.irsova.com/)
- She is the highest-ranked woman economist in the Czech Republic on RePEc, August 2026, and sixth in the world among economists who took their PhD in 2015 (RePEc cohort ranking). For publications in the last 10 years: third in the Czech Republic, 99th among women economists worldwide, and in the top 1.3% worldwide (983rd of 74,012 registered authors). [Source](https://ideas.repec.org/top/top.czech.html) [Source](https://ideas.repec.org/top/top.women10.html) [Source](https://ideas.repec.org/top/top.person.all10.html) [Source](https://ideas.repec.org/top/top.cohorts.html)
- Nearly 5,000 citations (4,965, Google Scholar, 8 October 2026) and h-index 28. [Source](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=LaHrICUAAAAJ)
- She is first and corresponding author of Spurious precision in meta-analysis of observational research (Nature Communications, 2025), introducing MAIVE. [Source](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-63261-0)
- Top Women Scientists in Czechia, Forbes Czechia (2025). [Source](https://forbes.cz/lists/top-vedkyne-ceska-2025/zuzana-havrankova/)
- Editors' Prize for the best paper published in Experimental Economics in 2022, Economic Science Association (2024), with Jindrich Matousek and Tomas Havranek. [Source](https://economicscience.org/news_manager.php?page=36768)
- Elected member, Academia Europaea (2023). [Source](https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Havrankova_Zuzana)
- Listed among the most influential women in Czech finance, #FinZeny (2022). [Source](https://meta-analysis.cz/about/)
- Katerina Smidkova Award for exceptionally high-quality publications, Czech Economic Society (2018). [Source](https://www.cse.cz/media/laureatkou-ceny-kateriny-smidkove-je-zuzana-havrankova)
- Selected for the Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting in economic sciences, Lindau Nobel Laureate Meetings (2017). [Source](https://meta-analysis.cz/about/)
- Economic Research Award, Czech National Bank (2015), with Tomas Havranek and Roman Horvath and Marek Rusnak. [Source](https://www.cnb.cz/cs/cnb-news/tiskove-zpravy/Cena-za-nejlepsi-vyzkumne-prace-CNB-00001)
- Governor's Award for the best dissertation relevant to monetary policy and financial stability, first place, National Bank of Slovakia (2015). [Source](https://www.cse.cz/media/laureatkou-ceny-kateriny-smidkove-je-zuzana-havrankova)
- Minister of Education's Prize for outstanding students and graduates, Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports of the Czech Republic (2013). [Source](https://iforum.cuni.cz/IFORUM-14873-version1.pdf)
- Medal for Research on Development, first place, Global Development Network (2010), with Tomas Havranek. [Source](https://iforum.cuni.cz/IFORUM-14873-version1.pdf)
- Professor of Economics, Charles University (2025). [Source](https://ies.fsv.cuni.cz/en/contacts/institute-members/73504033)
- Distinguished Senior Lecturer, Anglo-American University (2022). [Source](https://www.aauni.edu/directory/doc-phdr-zuzana-havrankova-ph-d/) [Source](https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Havrankova_Zuzana)
- Research Affiliate, Meta-Research Innovation Center at Stanford (METRICS) (2025-05). [Source](https://metrics.stanford.edu/people/zuzana-irsova)
- Associate Editor for meta-analysis, Journal of Economic Surveys (2024-01). [Source](https://ies.fsv.cuni.cz/en/news/zuzana-havrankova-became-new-associate-editor-journal-economic-surveys)
- Principal investigator, Junior Star METASPUR, Czech Science Foundation (2023–2027). [Source](https://science.fsv.cuni.cz/en/project/spurious-precision-in-meta-analysis-of-social-science-research-metaspur)
- Co-maintainer, meta-analysis.cz and EasyMeta.org. [Source](https://meta-analysis.cz/about/)

Zuzana Iršová Havránková je profesorkou ekonomie na Univerzitě Karlově, působí jako Distinguished Senior Lecturer na Anglo-American University v Praze a jako výzkumná spolupracovnice centra METRICS na Stanfordu. Zabývá se ekonomií trhu práce, mezinárodní ekonomií a metavýzkumem. Shromažďuje odhady z mnoha studií a zkoumá publikační zkreslení a spolehlivost empirických výsledků. Pochází z Rožňavy na Slovensku a žije v Litomyšli.
